title: Auxiliary Cash Bash on October 24
body:
The Auxiliary's second Cash Bash is Saturday, October 24, 2026. Tickets are $25. There are two $500 prizes, drawings every 10 minutes, $1 drafts and free food.

The first Cash Bash, in November 2025, sold out.
alt: The hall at the post, set with round tables

title: Renovation funding for the post
body: In October 2026, Sen. Frank Farry secured renovation funding for the post's building. Call the post for details.
alt: Post members with Sen. Frank Farry and a $50,000 check made out to VFW Post 6493

title: New leaders for the post and Auxiliary
body: In June 2026, Bill Zuk became Post Commander and Nichole Zuk became Auxiliary President. Evy Brennan stepped down as Auxiliary President.

title: VFW 60th and Auxiliary 50th anniversary
body: In September 2025 the post celebrated the VFW's 60th and the Auxiliary's 50th anniversary with a party at the post.
alt: Red, white and blue balloons and drapes for the anniversary party
